title: Preserve master fully-loaded transcript behavior on excluded forced partial-tail adoption
outcome: Preserve master fully-loaded transcript behavior on excluded forced partial-tail adoption
acceptance: Excluded remote, foreign-epoch and unpaired forced partial-tail adoption over a fully loaded transcript has exactly master's behavior; eligible local paired tail adoption still uses the owner's D6 suffix replacement.
Focused parity tests discriminate excluded master behavior from eligible D6 suffix restoration and pass on the corrected source.
